status.description: WO-047 (Issue #89): 'elevated_watch' and 'not_relevant' are additive. Existing four values and their order are unchanged.

watch_trigger.description: WO-049 (Issue #92) item 8. Required (non-null) by scripts/validate.py::impact_assessment_basis_problems (analysis/situation_validation.py) whenever status is 'elevated_watch' on a current_publication-dataset event: what observation would move this area to 'observed'/'potential' (confirmed) or clear it to 'no_material'/'not_relevant'. Makes the WO-047 'elevated_watch' enum value usable rather than merely valid. Optional/nullable on the schema itself, and the validate.py rule is scoped to dataset: current_publication only, so all 90 pre-WO-049 committed assessments (all historical_validation-dataset) stay valid unchanged.

no_material_basis.description: WO-049 item 8. Required (non-null) by scripts/validate.py::impact_assessment_basis_problems whenever status is 'no_material' on a current_publication-dataset event: the explicit negative operational evidence behind the finding, distinct from the event-level negative_operational_evidence flag it must accompany. Not enforced on historical_validation-dataset events -- nine of the 90 pre-WO-049 committed assessments (EVT-20240614-002) use 'no_material' with no basis recorded, predating this field.

not_relevant_basis.description: WO-049 item 8. Required (non-null) by scripts/validate.py::impact_assessment_basis_problems whenever status is 'not_relevant' on a current_publication-dataset event: why this area was assessed and found out of scope, rather than simply unassessed. Makes the WO-047 'not_relevant' enum value usable rather than merely valid.

supporting_claim_ids.description: WO-049 item 8. The Claim IDs that actually carry the assertions behind this assessment, distinct from evidence_ids (the projected event_evidence rows). Optional; an empty array is legal and means no claim has been linked yet.
